module: Internal BeamNG tool to generate the JSON data and resources (images copied with a name based on the SHA1 hash) that feed the online documentation (Hugo system). For each available language, it exports the list of levels and vehicles (models and configurations); it also exports the game version, physical materials, JBeam defaults, JBeam statistics and tested game controllers (from /settings/inputmaps/). Everything is written to the doc-out/ folder (data/ and resources/). Of little use to a modder, except as an example of accessing the level/vehicle lists.
notes: Both functions start a job (core_jobsystem): processing is asynchronous and prints DONE to the console at the end.
The script changes the game language (Lua.userLanguage, reloadLanguages, onSettingsChanged hook) for each language; the original language is not restored at the end.

Bug: in getTestedControllers, the vidpid mismatch error message contains `dumps(out.vidpid)".. vs filename "` (missing .. operator before the string), which is a function call on a string and would cause a Lua error if the two identifiers differ.

run.desc: Creates an asynchronous job that generates all the documentation data (levels, vehicles per language, then common data) in doc-out/data/ and doc-out/resources/.

runAndQuit.desc: Like run(), but exits the game (shutdown(0)) once generation is finished. Intended for command-line generation.
